summary: Globant S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching its Q2 2026 earnings release and announcing the appointment of Sarabdeep Narang as Chief Executive Officer of its Glob.AI unit, effective August 18, 2026. The appointment is a routine senior management addition, not an abrupt or forced departure. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction. The forward-looking statements cover standard risks. This is a routine earnings and executive-hiring disclosure for a foreign private issuer, with no extraordinary corporate event meriting special-situations classification. What to watch: none; this is an ordinary operational update.
